title: Digitally-Driven Surgical Guide for Alveoloplasty Prior to Immediate Denture Placement
content: This article presents a step-by-step technique for fabricating a 3D-printed surgical guide for alveoloplasty in preparation for immediate denture placement. The process integrates digital impressions, digital design tools, and additive manufacturing technologies. This method ensures precise ridge recontouring and verification, enhancing surgical predictability and prosthetic fit.
